sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]Love sits en[D]throned in [C]ageless [G]splendor: [C]Come, and a[G]dore the [Am7]might[D7]y [G]One.
[D]He has made [Em]known His [C]great sal[G]va[D]tion [G]Which all His [C]friends with [Am]joy con[B]fess:

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]Peal out the [D]praise of [C]grace a[G]bounding, [C]Calling the [G]whole world [Am7]to [D7]re[G]joice.
[Em]All things that [Bm]live in [C]earth and [G]o[D]cean, [G]Make music [C]for your [G/D]mighty [D7]King. [G]

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [G]Mountains and [D]stones look [C]up a[G]doring, [C]And find a [G]voice to [Am7]praise [D7]His [G]name.
[Em]Just is our [Bm]God, whose [C]truth vic[G]to[D]rious, [G]Establish[C]es the [G/D]world in [D7]peace. [G]
